description: UPME’s geographic information service links interactive energy and mining viewers, an inventory of geographic information and a map-service catalogue. The sector geoportal brings together geographic services from participating agencies. The provider is UPME. Coverage: Coverage is Colombia’s energy and mining resources and infrastructure. Dataset scale, dates and coordinate systems differ by linked layer. Access: The public agency service page and its described access routes were read. GIS layers and service responses were not downloaded. Licence and cost: The page does not establish a reuse licence or complete cost conditions. Provider confirmation is required before reuse. Limitations: The portal is a collection-level entry. It does not establish a shared open licence, complete national asset coverage or one data date. For simulation it provides official discovery and service routes for infrastructure and resource mapping. Related resources: No existing catalogue record explicitly covers this UPME geographic collection.
